newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Vision Systems signs deal with Abbott.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Vision Systems signs deal with Abbott.

text.p: Technology company Vision Systems Ltd said on Wednesday its Australian Biomedical Corp Ltd subsidiary had signed a worldwide exclusive distribution agreement with Abbott Laboratories' Diagnostic.

Company secretary Euon Pizzey said in a statement the United States-based health care product manufacturer would market and distribute an automated Haematology slide maker and stainer, developed and manufactured by Australian Biomedical.
Vision System director Peter Murphy told Reuters the instrument was nearing the end of development phase and manufacture was expected to begin towards the end of 1996/97.
The distribution agreement would not impact on the company's earnings in this financial year, but would have a major impact in the years following, he said.
"(Australian Biomedical) represents about 15 percent of Vision Systems' business and, with the opportunities ahead for this instrument, it could be a greater proportion," he said.
Murphy said he could not quantify sales prospects as the instrument, which automatically prepared and stained blood smears for testing, was an innovative entry into a new market.
However he said the total haemotology instrument market was worth about US$1 billion annually, with Abbott, which achieved sales of US$10 billion in 1995, one of its top three suppliers.
"I cannot quantify the impact (on earnings of the deal) but certainly it will have a major impact in the years ahead," he said.
Murphy said the agreement with Abbott, signed for a minimum five years, also provided for future development of other haematology instruments.
